Capstone Estimates

    EPS CY27 & CY28 — revision path

    Consensus and Street Hi for the same fixed calendar year (BEst @ <yr>BC — the Comp Sheet's own basis), weekly since Jan-25. Unlike the NTM/2Y chart above, the period does not roll: the slope here is pure revision, not a change of period. % in the title = first-to-last point of each line.

    Capex CY27 & CY28 — revision path

    Same fixed-year basis, shown as positive spend. Bloomberg carries capex as a negative (cash outflow), so BEST_CAPEX_HI is the least negative = the lowest spend — "Street Hi" here is the top of the spend range (largest absolute of the two tails, and always ≥ consensus). Capex coverage is thinner than EPS: a blank chart means the Street doesn't model it for that name. The tails also carry the odd junk contributor (ANET's hi hit $13.7bn against a $911mm consensus; TSM shows $241bn) — when one spike would flatten every other line the y-axis stops at the credible mass and the title says how many points went off-scale. Nothing is dropped, and the consensus leg is never clipped.
